# Implementation Plan
<!-- Generated by handover v0.2.0 -->

## Open Questions to Resolve First
- [ ] Should the backend use FastAPI (Python) or Express (Node)?
- [ ] Should reminders use a simple browser setInterval, a service worker, or a backend cron job with web push?

## Tasks
- [ ] Define data models *(high priority)*
  Create SQLAlchemy models for User, IntakeLog (id, user_id, amount_ml, logged_at, notes), and Goal (user_id, daily_target_ml, reminder_interval_min)
- [ ] Set up database migrations *(high priority)*
  Add Alembic migrations for the defined models
- [ ] Build CRUD API for intake logs *(high priority)*
  Implement REST endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting intake log entries
- [ ] Implement JWT authentication *(high priority)*
  Add user auth with JWT tokens to secure API endpoints
- [ ] Scaffold React frontend *(high priority)*
  Set up Vite + React project with React Router, Tailwind CSS, and an axios API client
- [ ] Build dashboard page *(high priority)*
  Create a dashboard with a circular progress ring showing today's intake vs goal, quick-add buttons (200ml, 350ml, 500ml, custom), and today's log list
- [ ] Build settings page
  Allow users to set daily water intake goal and reminder interval
- [ ] Build history and charts view
  Add a bar chart showing daily totals for the past 7 or 30 days and a streak counter
- [ ] Implement reminders
  Add browser notification permission flow and interval-based reminders with a toggle in settings
- [ ] PWA polish
  Add manifest.json, service worker, and offline support so the app works like a native app on mobile
